scripts.build: npm run seo:generate && tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.mjs --configLoader native
scripts.build:production: npm run seo:generate:strict && tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.mjs --configLoader native
scripts.build:analyze: npm run seo:generate && tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.mjs --configLoader native --mode analyze
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix server run build && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm --prefix server run db:validate && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server test && npm run build && node scripts/smoke-render.mjs && node scripts/smoke-admin-render.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
